author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅವನಿಡುವ ಗುರಿಯೊಂದು ನಿನ್ನ ಲಕ್ಷ್ಯವೆ ಬೇರೆ
ಭವಗುರಿಯ ಸಾಧಿಸಲು ತನದಾರಿಗೆಳೆವ
ಬವಣೆನೀಡುತಲೊಮ್ಮೆ ನಿನಗುರಿಯ ತಪ್ಪಿಸುವ
ಹವಣಿಸುತ ಗುರಿಗೆಲುವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: He sets one goal; your aim is something else;
to fulfil the goal of this life, he pulls you onto his own path;
once, giving you trouble, he makes you miss your goal;
striving hard, you win your goal, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Our plans and the Divine’s plan often differ. Sometimes hardship turns us from our own aims onto a larger path, and with effort we still reach the goal, perhaps a truer one.
